About UsWelcome to Luxurious Heritage Hotel

The richly designed lobby, once you step inside the newly built hotel, will further take you to the spaciously appointed rooms with modern amenities. “Luxurious Heritage Hotel” also features casual dining restaurants offering delicious food to satisfy an epicurean's palate and banqueting with all facilities to enable you to conduct your business efficiently and smoothly. So, if you are looking for luxury and comfort at an affordable price, we don't think you could find a better place than “Luxurious Heritage Hotel”.

LuxuriousRooms

Single Room

With modern style and furniture, the room is equipped with 2 double beds or one king size bed, mini bar, sofa and terrace or balcony where you can enjoy the beautiful views.

Book Now

Classic Double Room

Superior Ocean Front rooms come with direct views over the ocean and are equipped with 2 beds or 1 king size bed, a sofa, air conditioning, alarm clock and a safety deposit box.
